title: GST Network adds metro rail as fifth mode of transport in e-way bill system
summary: GSTN has introduced metro rail as a new mode of transport in the e-way bill system. This addition follows a government notification released on October 26, enhancing transport options for users. The e-way bill system now includes five modes: Road, Rail, Air, Ship, and Metro Rail. Users must select metro rail and enter transport document numbers for transactions.
